detail: Central Banking's award profile states that the Czech National Bank and BNP Paribas Asset Management agreed a new $500 million mortgage-backed securities mandate in November 2019; the profile describes a managed mandate, not advice or custody.
source_title: Asset manager: BNP Paribas Asset Management (Central Banking Awards 2021)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that BNP Paribas Asset Management manages a fixed income mandate in US dollars for the Central Bank of Aruba, and quotes the bank's president Jeanette Semeleer saying that when the bank needed advice it could count on the firm; the profile describes management of a mandate plus advice.
source_title: Asset manager: BNP Paribas Asset Management (Central Banking Awards 2021)

detail: Central Banking's award profile states that the Central Bank of Hungary (MNB) awarded BNP Paribas Asset Management another mortgage mandate, for US agency mortgage-backed securities, in 2018, and quotes the MNB's Robert Rekasi saying the knowledge transfer the firm provides is crucial; the profile describes a managed mandate plus training.
source_title: Innovation in reserve management: BNP Paribas Asset Management (Central Banking Awards 2019)

name_as_stated: le departement de la tresorerie de la Banque mondiale
detail: Financial Afrik reports that the governor of the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie, Sid'Ahmed Ould Raiss, and the World Bank's vice-president and treasurer Madelyn Antoncic signed a cooperation agreement on foreign exchange reserve management on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank spring meetings, and that the World Bank treasury department will provide technical assistance to the BCM covering training of reserve staff, organisation of the relevant structures and the eventual setting up of a trading room; the source describes technical assistance and training, not management of assets.
source_title: Mauritanie/Banque mondiale: convention pour la gestion des reserves en devises (Financial Afrik)

detail: Semanario Universidad reports that the Banco Central de Costa Rica hired BlackRock as a co-administrator of its international reserves in 2017 and that BlackRock holds 5.5 percent of the reserves, about $352 million, with the BCCR telling the paper that hiring external portfolio managers is a usual practice in central banking; this is management of assets.
source_title: BlackRock: el golpeado gigante que administra reservas en dolares del Banco Central (Semanario Universidad)
